episodes.title: I Need You
episodes.summary: Ryo, a young professor returning from research abroad, takes his pure-hearted, crybaby friend Akira to a decadent party, where things turn demonic.

episodes.title: One Hand Is Enough
episodes.summary: Akira has become a completely different man -- he's stronger and hungrier than ever before. He seeks out Ryo for answers.

episodes.title: Believe Me!
episodes.summary: After getting shut down by his editor, paparazzo Nagasaki gets desperate. Silene and Kaim learn what happened to their missing fellow demon, Amon.

episodes.title: Come, Akira
episodes.summary: Akira's mother calls and says she'll be home soon. Everyone is looking forward to seeing her, but Ryo warns Akira not to trust any human.

episodes.title: Beautiful Silene
episodes.summary: Silene tracks down Amon, hoping to reawaken his demonic side. But in the ensuing battle, the human soul of Akira remains powerful.

episodes.title: Neither Demon Nor Human
episodes.summary: At a widely broadcast track meet, Ryo plans to expose high school athlete Koda as a demon, thereby spreading fear and distrust throughout society.

episodes.title: Weak Humans, Wise Demons
episodes.summary: With the fear of demons gripping the world, humanity devolves into paranoia and violence. Akira tries to save other demon-human hybrids like himself.

episodes.title: I Must Know Myself
episodes.summary: Ryo's actions and motives remain a mystery to himself, so he revisits his past for answers. Miki's father searches for his missing wife and son.

episodes.title: Go to Hell, You Mortals
episodes.summary: Betrayed and exposed, Akira becomes a target. After Miki takes to social media to defend his human soul, she and Miko find themselves under attack.

episodes.title: Crybaby
episodes.summary: Confronted by Akira, Ryo reveals the truth about demonkind and himself. Humans, demons and devilmen gather for an ultimate battle for the world.
